milestones.en: Formula 1 debut with Toro Rosso, aged 17.
milestones.zh: 17 岁代表 Toro Rosso 完成 F1 首秀。

milestones.en: Won the Spanish Grand Prix on his Red Bull Racing debut, becoming F1’s youngest race winner.
milestones.zh: 红牛首战即赢得西班牙大奖赛，成为 F1 最年轻分站冠军。

milestones.en: Four consecutive Formula 1 drivers’ championships with Red Bull Racing.
milestones.zh: 与红牛车队连续四年夺得 F1 车手世界冠军。

copy.statement: Four titles. One racing instinct. From a first win with Red Bull to a legacy in Formula 1. Always looking for the next challenge.
copy.galleryTitles: 2021. 2022. 2023. 2024. Four consecutive Formula 1 drivers’ titles with Red Bull.
copy.galleryDebut: A Red Bull debut. A Spanish Grand Prix victory. Formula 1’s youngest race winner, in 2016.

onTrack.en: Formula 1 with Red Bull. Four drivers’ titles, won in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024.

offTrack.en: Beyond F1: GT racing and sim racing with Verstappen Racing.
offTrack.zh: 赛道之外：与 Verstappen Racing 一起探索 GT 赛车与模拟赛车。

worlds.en: Verstappen Racing connects GT racing and Verstappen Sim Racing, formerly Team Redline.
worlds.zh: 从 GT 赛车到模拟赛道：Verstappen Sim Racing 原名 Team Redline，现属于 Verstappen Racing 的竞速世界。
